description: The session log of the run: the setup it started from, and every edit since (the tools, settings changed, the adaptive mesh’s re-meshes), each with the step it was applied at, with the run’s diagnostics along the way. The page’s Save session log button saves the same. Returns a summary: the setup, whether it can be replayed, the actions by kind and the steps they span. save_path writes the full log as JSON, for replay.

save_path.description: Write the session log as JSON to this file

name: session_log
